changes: Month field cleared: 'ṛtāṣādri(!)' is corrupt, and reading it as the month Āṣāḍha is only a guess. It now appears only in the notes, as one possible reading alongside a corrupt chronogram.
Notes: the colophon is now quoted as written ('yadi sudho mama sudho vā'), with the standard formula given as the probable intended reading.
No persons, date era, year or ce_approx changed. ŚS 1614 + 78 = 1692 CE is confirmed.

notes: The colophon names no persons. 'ṛtāṣādri(!)' is marked corrupt by the cataloguer. It could be a word-numeral chronogram (ṛtu = 6, adri = 7, perhaps āśā = 10), but no right-to-left reading gives 1614 cleanly. It could also be a garbled month name (Āṣāḍha), but this is uncertain, so the month is left empty. The closing words 'yadi sudho mama sudho vā mama doṣo na dīyate' are a corrupt form of the usual scribal apology (yadi śuddham aśuddhaṃ vā mama doṣo na dīyate). ŚS 1614 = c. 1692 CE, which matches the catalogue field.
